submittedText: Artificial intelligence is a major aspect of our everyday lives and workplace. It can automate tasks and decisions. There are advantages and disadvantages to the implementation of AI at work. It can help tasks become more efficient and complete at a faster rate than before without taking away from the effort put in by the worker. This allows the worker to focus on other creative and strategic tasks. There are some concerns regarding the use of AI such as data privacy, bias in algorithmic decisions, displacement of jobs, and how reliable automated decisions are. Companies should weigh in on the positives and negatives of AI technology. When used appropriately, AI can be very beneficial to the workplace. Companies that use AI technology, ethical guidelines, and human judgment can maximize the benefits and mitigate the potential negative impacts.
